text: Explain to others what you want to understand more deeply yourself. The best way to structure and deepen your knowledge is to try to explain it to another person in simple words. In the process of explanation you will discover gaps in your logic and see the essence much more clearly. From the point of view of esotericism, the space of ajna expands (if, of course, you manage to activate this chakra in your interlocutor as well), and therefore fundamentally new ideas, unexpected conclusions, and insights arise...
